contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]ANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ [GLORIA EXERC]ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), possibly Trier mint, Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped right. Obverse inscription: [--]ANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERC]ITVS. In exergue: possibly TRS. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin.…
